goals.description: Read the project Next.js critical fixes guidance and inspect existing frontend components for established implementation examples before making changes.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on gathering context. Read `docs/agent/architecture/nextjs-critical-fixes.md` and review relevant examples under `apps/frontend/components/`. Do not start broad edits yet; identify patterns you should follow in the later goals.
goals.name: Inspect performance guidance and patterns

goals.description: Update relevant React and Next.js data fetching so independent fetches run concurrently, slow data is wrapped in Suspense boundaries, and awaits are deferred into branches when appropriate.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on data-fetching performance. Look for sequential awaits that are independent, slow fetches without `<Suspense>`, and awaits happening earlier than necessary. Apply `Promise.all()`, Suspense boundaries, and branch-local awaits where they match the code’s behavior.
goals.name: Fix data-fetching waterfalls

goals.description: Ensure icon imports are direct, heavy components are dynamically imported, and analytics or browser-only heavy code is deferred from SSR where appropriate.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on bundle size only. Replace barrel imports such as package-level `lucide-react` icon imports with direct icon module imports. Use `next/dynamic` for heavy components such as editors, charts, or PDF viewers, and defer analytics/browser-only heavy code with `ssr: false` when appropriate.
goals.name: Reduce client bundle size

goals.description: Verify Server Actions perform authentication inside the action itself and check resource ownership before mutations.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on Server Actions. For any action you touch or audit, ensure auth is checked inside the action, not only in middleware or calling code. Before mutations, verify the authenticated user owns or may access the target resource.
goals.name: Harden Server Actions

goals.description: Ensure production assumptions use build-and-start workflows and Docker uses Next.js standalone output rather than development mode.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on production run configuration. Check scripts, docs, Dockerfiles, or deployment config you are responsible for so production uses `npm run build && npm run start`, not `npm run dev`, and Docker uses standalone output rather than dev mode.
goals.name: Check production execution configuration

goals.description: Validate the final changes against the skill checklist for data fetching, bundle imports, dynamic loading, Server Action auth, and Suspense coverage.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on final validation. Review the changed code against the checklist: no sequential awaits for independent data, icons imported directly, heavy components use `next/dynamic`, Server Actions have auth inside, and slow fetches are covered by Suspense. Address any missed item within its narrow scope.
goals.name: Run performance PR checklist
